insight: Founded by former Adobe CTO Abhay Parasnis; reached a $1B valuation in 2023 on a $100M Series B led by Salesforce Ventures.
name: Typeface
tagline: Enterprise generative-AI platform for on-brand marketing content at scale.
description: Typeface is an enterprise marketing platform that orchestrates AI agents, brand guidelines, and approval workflows to generate on-brand text and images across campaigns and channels. Its Brand Hub captures a company's voice and assets so output stays consistent, while agents handle planning, creation, and performance analysis. It targets large marketing teams that need governed, secure content generation rather than one-off copy.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates AI agents over multiple underlying foundation models.

edge: Enterprise brand governance: a Brand Hub captures company voice and assets and gates agent output through approval workflows at scale.

references.title: What is Typeface AI? A 2025 overview of the platform
